subject: lemon shark
title: Lemon Sharks Roam for a Decade, Then Come Home to Give Birth

scenes.text: These sharks leave home as kids. Years later, the females come back.
At Bimini in the Bahamas, scientists tagged more than 2,000 baby lemon sharks over almost two decades.
Pups stay in a shallow mangrove lagoon until about five to eight years old, then roam for roughly ten years.
DNA tests showed at least six females born there came back 14 to 17 years later to give birth.
One gave birth less than three miles from where her own mother had been caught.
It was the first proof that sharks return to their own birthplace to have their pups.

description:
Lemon sharks born in the mangrove nursery at Bimini, Bahamas, come back to the same place to give birth.
Researchers sampled the nursery every year from 1995 to 2012 and tagged more than 2,000 young sharks. Genetic profiling showed at least six females born there in the 1990s returned 14 to 17 years later to give birth, the first evidence of natal philopatry in sharks (Molecular Ecology, 2014).
Which animal has the most impressive sense of home?
thumbnail_text: SHARKS COME HOME TO GIVE BIRTH
first_comment: Sea turtles were famous for this. Sharks were only proven to do it after nearly 20 years of DNA sampling. Which animal homecoming amazes you most?
